captions.detailed: A compact rectangular air purifier unit in light grey with a dark grey slatted lower front panel. The slatted lower panel is hinged on the side to rotate outward, revealing an internal prismatic filter that slides out horizontally. A small black rocker switch is centered on the top panel, pivoting on a local revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact room-scale air purifier with a main light grey body, a hinged dark grey front slatted panel, a prismatic sliding internal filter, and a small black rocker switch on top. Ensure the lower panel rotates on a side hinge, the filter slides out, and the switch pivots.
captions.factory: Construct the main body as a box with a hollowed lower front cavity. Model the slatted front door using a box with vertical rectangular through-slots, and attach it via a revolute joint on the left edge. Create the internal filter as a simple solid block positioned inside the cavity, connected via a prismatic joint. Model the top rocker switch using small box primitives and attach it to the top face with a revolute joint.
